name: plan-validate-emits-wrong-remediation-for-ellipsis-in-plan-text-should-deny-with-strip-ellipses-message
description: Live repro from ~/.claude/projects/-home-tim-Coding-nixos/e05c9f83-d2ae-4b48-84d9-6296f5e5905d.jsonl (2026-04-28, line 161 firing tool toolu_01GZ9fW5pyv1ud43y4pbFy4S). Two-layer regression: (1) the bash blacklist regex /\btail\s+/ in src/utils/command-patterns.ts originally matched the literal word 'tail' anywhere — including inside string literals embedded in shell commands — so a command like `node -e 'console.log("Capture the tail in the enriched sentinel")'` was denied with the nonsense suffix 'Use Read tool with offset'; (2) the deterministic fastDeny was further masked by the tool-approve appeal LLM (appealable per src/rules/tool-approve.ts:19), which consistently OVERTURNED a correct check-redirect deny on `node -e` because TOOL_APPEAL_AGENT.systemPrompt's Rule 2 NEVER-OVERTURN list omitted code-execution interpreters and Rule 3's 'Used node/python/other language' wording was misread when node IS the denied command. Both layers are fixed: (a) src/utils/command-patterns.ts now scopes the cat/head/tail head-command match to the executable head of each shell command segment (split on ;, &&, ||, and & with a (?!\d) lookahead preserving 2>&1; pipe `|` remains non-separating; quoted spans stripped before splitting); (b) src/utils/agent-configs.ts strengthens Rule 4 (CHECK-REDIRECT) to TRUMP Rules 1/2/3, extends Rule 2's NEVER-OVERTURN list to cover node/python/python3/ruby/perl direct invocations including -e/-c/-r/--eval inline scripts, and tightens Rule 3 with a precondition that fails when the BLOCK REASON names the same runtime being attempted; src/agents/hooks/tool-appeal.ts now extracts the denied-command token from canonical resolveCheckMessage shapes and surfaces it inside the DENIAL CLASS block. Now passes deterministically 3/3.

The upstream src/utils/command-patterns.ts head-command scoping fix removes the bogus 'Use Read tool with offset' suffix; the appeal-LLM tightening in src/utils/agent-configs.ts (Rule 4 trumps Rules 2/3, Rule 2 NEVER-OVERTURN extended for node/python/ruby/perl, Rule 3 precondition narrowed) plus the denied-command-token surfacing in src/agents/hooks/tool-appeal.ts ensures the deterministic fastDeny is no longer overturned. No env.llm_stubs needed — the appeal correctly UPHOLDs on real LLM calls.
